title: Unique Nutty Korean Almond Bibimbap
description: A nutty and glassy-jelly Korean dish featuring ground almonds and coconut cream, perfect for post-workout meals. This ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly bibimbap is served in a cazuela.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced zucchini and carrots and cook until they are tender.
Add the shiitake mushrooms and cook until they are softened.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut cream and soy sauce.
Add the cooked jasmine rice to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate pan, toast the ground almonds over low heat until fragrant.
To assemble the bibimbap, place a scoop of the rice mixture in the bottom of a cazuela.
Add the cooked vegetables and mushrooms on top of the rice.
Sprinkle the toasted ground almonds and gomasio over the top.
